content:
Looking at the folds: each fold line passes through the center of the octagon, so after three folds the corner of the triangle that corresponds to the center of the octagon is the one where all fold creases meet. The cut removes this corner perpendicular to a fold edge.

When unfolded, each of the 8 layers contributes a congruent triangular notch at the center. These eight notches combine around the center point: reflecting and rotating the cut line across the fold lines (vertical, horizontal, and diagonal) produces four straight edges forming a square hole in the middle of the octagon, while the outer boundary of the octagon remains completely intact.

This matches the picture showing the intact octagon with a square hole in the center.

\boxed{B}
